XYhai: Double Machine Learning for marketing decisions

XYhai: causal inference with Double Machine Learning (DML) for cross-funnel marketing decision support

Septeni Japan · Data Analyst · Dec 2024

Summary

XYhai is Septeni's solution for supporting advertisers' marketing decisions across touchpoints. In December 2024, Septeni announced that a causal inference scheme based on Double Machine Learning (DML), developed through joint research with Google, had been introduced into it. Hiroto Fukada worked on this as a Data Analyst at Septeni Japan.

The scheme reflects the causal structure between marketing interventions and maps user behaviour from ad exposure through to conversion. That makes it possible to estimate the incremental effect of individual tactics - television commercials, social advertising, and search advertising - instead of reading correlation as if it were effect.

Why it matters

Advertisers allocate budget across channels that interact with each other: a television campaign changes how many people search, and search advertising then collects the conversion. Conventional measurement gives credit to whichever touchpoint appears last, so it cannot separate the incremental contribution of one tactic from the effect of the others.

The cost of getting this wrong is concrete. Budget moves toward the channel that is best at claiming credit rather than the one that actually changes behaviour, and the error compounds every planning cycle. A causal framing is what makes the difference between attributing outcomes and explaining them.

Results

The DML-based scheme was implemented in XYhai and announced publicly in December 2024. It supports situation-specific analysis of intervention effects across television, social, and search advertising, and turns the estimates into practical outputs: budget optimisation proposals and effect predictions aligned with observed user behaviour.

The limits are stated as part of the method rather than hidden. Spot campaigns with less than roughly one month of broadcast data are difficult to evaluate with this scheme, and area testing is used to improve data quality in those cases.

Project at a glance

Problem
Marketers needed to evaluate the incremental effect of individual tactics (TV, social, and search advertising) and reflect the results in budget allocation, but conventional measurement could not capture the causal structure among tactics.
Role
Data Analyst
Domain
Marketing Science / Causal Inference
Methods
Double Machine Learning (DML), Heterogeneous treatment effect (HTE) estimation, Causal graph modeling, Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM)
Outcome
Introduced a DML-based causal inference scheme into XYhai, Septeni's marketing decision-support solution, enabling situation-specific ROI and incremental-KPI analysis. Announced in a press release in December 2024.
